Islington College | Big Data and Data Mining
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
LAB ASSIGNMENT: SSIS Data Flow Transformations
Objective:
Learn and implement various SSIS data flow transformations by building ETL packages that extract, transform,
and load data using different transformation components.
Prerequisites:
(cid:127) SQL Server Data Tools (SSDT) or Visual Studio with SSIS installed
(cid:127) Access to SQL Server database with Sales.Customer and Pricing tables
(cid:127) Basic understanding of SSIS data flow components
Lab Tasks:
Task 1: Review Demonstration
In class, we implemented an ETL package with:
(cid:127) Source: ADO.NET Source (Connection 1)
(cid:127) Transformations: Character Map and Aggregate transformations
(cid:127) Destination: ADO.NET Destination (Connection 2)
(cid:127) Tables: Sales.Customer and Pricing tables
Task 2: Explore SSIS Transformations
Visit the Microsoft documentation at: SSIS Transformations Reference
Study at least 5-6 different transformation types and understand their purposes.
Task 3: Implement New Transformations
Create a new SSIS package that includes at least 2-3 different transformations (other than Character Map
and Aggregate). Use the same source tables (Sales.Customer and Pricing) or similar tables from your
database.
Suggested transformations to explore: Derived Column, Conditional Split, Lookup, Merge Join, Data
Conversion, Sort, Union All, Multicast
Deliverables:
1 SSIS Package (.dtsx file) - Your complete SSIS solution
2 Screenshots - Data flow design showing all transformations with connections
3 Documentation - Brief explanation (1-2 paragraphs) for each transformation used: purpose, configuration,
and output
4 Sample Output - Screenshots of transformed data or destination table results
Submission Guidelines:
Submit all deliverables in a single ZIP file named YourName_SSIS_Lab.zip through the course portal by the
assigned deadline.
Note: Focus on understanding how each transformation processes data. Experiment with different
configurations and observe the results.
